title: Missing quotes
prompt: The robot wants to print the word Hello, but without quotes Godot thinks Hello is the name of something, and there is nothing by that name. Fix it so it prints "Hello".
hints: Text you want shown as-is needs double quotes around it.
The error says Hello is not declared.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
